name: useNaturalLanguageAI
summary: Translation, language detection, smart replies and entity extraction, running on the device.
plain: Language tools that run on the phone: translate between the languages ML Kit Translate supports (each language model downloads once), work out what language some text is in, suggest replies to a conversation, and pull out things like dates, addresses and tracking numbers from English text.
description: Wraps the ML Kit language stack through pixel-nano: language-id, translate, smart-reply and entity-extraction. Translation models download per language pair on first use and then run offline, which is why the first call for a new pair is slower. Translation accepts only the language tags ML Kit Translate supports; any other tag rejects with E_NANO_UNSUPPORTED_LANGUAGE (surfaced in error, result null) and no other language is substituted. Smart reply takes a short conversation history and proposes replies. Entity extraction works on English text only and returns typed spans with their positions in the original string.

returns.name: isProcessing
returns.desc: True while any language operation runs.

returns.name: languageResult
returns.desc: Detected BCP-47 code plus alternatives with confidence scores.

returns.name: translationResult
returns.desc: Translated text with the source and target languages.

returns.name: smartReplyResult
returns.desc: Suggested replies for the supplied conversation.

returns.name: entityResult
returns.desc: Typed entities with their start and end offsets.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: 'hardware' once at least one on-device operation has returned a result; 'unavailable' before that or when the native module is absent. There is no 'simulated' value.

actions.name: identifyLanguage(text)
actions.desc: Detects the language of a sample. Run it before translating when the source is unknown.

inputs.name: text
inputs.desc: A sample; a few words is usually enough.

actions.output: Resolves with { languageCode, possibleLanguages, latencyMs, source } — languageCode is null when nothing was confident enough — or null on failure.

actions.name: translate(text, from?, to?)
actions.type: (text: string, sourceLang?: string, targetLang?: string) => Promise<TranslationResult | null>
actions.desc: Translates on-device. The first call for a language pair downloads that model, so it is slower than the ones after it. An unsupported language tag fails instead of falling back to another language.

inputs.name: sourceLang
inputs.desc: Language tag of the input, one that ML Kit Translate supports (for example 'en', 'de', 'zh'). Defaults to 'en'. Unsupported tags reject.

inputs.name: targetLang
inputs.desc: Language tag to translate into, one that ML Kit Translate supports. Defaults to 'es'. Unsupported tags reject.

actions.output: Resolves with { translatedText, sourceLanguage, targetLanguage, latencyMs, source }, or null on failure.

actions.name: suggestReplies(history)
actions.type: (history: { text: string; timestamp?: number; isLocalUser?: boolean; sender?: string }[]) => Promise<SmartReplyResult | null>
actions.desc: Proposes short replies for the end of a conversation.

inputs.name: history
inputs.desc: Messages in order. isLocalUser marks this user's own messages, so the model replies to the other party.

actions.output: Resolves with { suggestions, status, latencyMs, source }. suggestions is empty when the model has nothing confident to offer; null on failure.

actions.name: extractEntities(text)
actions.desc: Finds dates, addresses, money, phone numbers, flight numbers and tracking codes in English text. Other languages are not supported.
actions.output: Resolves with { entities, latencyMs, source }; each entity carries type, text and the start and end offsets into your input. Null on failure.

agentNote: Warn the user that a first translation for a new language pair downloads a model. Do not assume identifyLanguage succeeds; languageCode can be null for very short input.
